clues.it: Vito era accanto a un barile e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Vito was beside a barrel and north of Nino.

clues.it: Olga era nella 2ª riga e accanto a una pianta, ma non era accanto a una pozza.
clues.en: Olga was in the 2nd row and beside a plant, but was not beside a puddle.

clues.it: Marta era accanto a una corda e a nord di Bruno.
clues.en: Marta was beside a rope coil and north of Bruno.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a uno scaffale e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a shelf and north of Nino.

clues.it: Paolo era nella 5ª colonna e da solo in Cabina, ma non era accanto a un barile.
clues.en: Paolo was in the 5th column and alone in the Cabin, but was not beside a barrel.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Dario era nella 7ª riga, accanto a una cassa e a ovest di Nino.
clues.en: Dario was in the 7th row, beside a crate and west of Nino.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a un salvagente e in una stanza diversa da Rosa.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a life ring and in a different room from Rosa.

clues.it: Tea era in una stanza diversa da Nino.
clues.en: Tea was in a different room from Nino.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 8th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Paolo lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Paolo's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 4th.

steps.it: Olga può stare solo nella 2ª riga: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Olga can only be in the 2nd row: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 1st, column 2nd.

steps.it: Paolo può stare solo nella 5ª colonna: escludendola, a Rosa resta una sola casella: riga 4ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Paolo can only be in the 5th column: ruling it out leaves Rosa a single square: row 4th, column 6th.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Bruno resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Bruno a single square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 3ª colonna, e lì a Marta resta una sola casella libera: la 3ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 3rd column, and it leaves Marta a single free square there: the 3rd row.

steps.it: L'indizio generale «2 persone in Cambusa» non torna senza Tea: deve stare in riga 9ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: The general clue “2 people in the Galley” cannot add up without Tea: they must be at row 9th, column 1st.

steps.it: Nino può stare solo nella 9ª colonna.
steps.en: Nino can only be in the 9th column.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Nino resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Nino a single square: row 6th, column 9th.
